exactHashAudit.audit: R213 read-only exact media SHA-256 stream audit
exactHashAudit.interpretation: An exact matching SHA-256 proves identical downloaded bytes, including across different URLs. Different hashes or unavailable hashes do not clear re-encoded, transformed, or visually identical content. Cross-channel use is recorded separately and is not a same-channel duplicate. Exact SHA matches reused only across distinct channels in the current same-hash groups are cross-channel placements, not same-channel duplicate candidates.

perceptualAudit.audit: R213 bounded read-only video perceptual fingerprint audit

featureMethod.ffprobe: duration, codec, dimensions, average frame rate
featureMethod.ffmpegSampling: fps=1; full frame and centered 80% crop; grayscale 32x32; normalized absolute pixel error and 64-bit dHash
featureMethod.alignment: minimum average error over integer offsets -2 to +2 seconds

contactSheets.framesPerSheet: up to 8 evenly sampled frames across each clip

featureMethod.interpretation: Fingerprint rankings are triage only, not proof of identical creative or duplicate status. Similar product/scene templates can score close; encoding, edits, crop, overlays, timing, and platform transforms can score apart.

sameChannelDifferentSHA.scoreLimitNote: The ranking helps prioritize frame review. At 1 fps and 32x32 it may miss shot-level or heavily edited re-encodes; low error can arise from common ad templates, and high error can arise from edits/crops. Human source/master identity review remains required.

perceptualAudit.conclusion: No automatic duplicate decision. A low-distance candidate needs human frame/contact-sheet review and master/source identity context. Different URLs or different SHA remain insufficient to declare novel creative.

humanTriage.observation: These top-ranked different-SHA pairs depict distinct products and distinct product images; no same-film match was apparent. Full-frame scores were unusually close because the portrait ad template/letterboxing is shared. The top-25 observed captions also refer to distinct products; this is a triage finding, not a global duplicate clearance.
humanTriage.nextReview: Root can inspect all 21 retained contact sheets in contact-sheets/; no post was classified or changed automatically.

rootVisualTriage.verdict: Ähnliche Layouts, aber unterschiedliche Produkte und Bilder. Kein Beleg für dasselbe neu codierte Video.

limits: Nur gelieferte Metricool-Datensätze07.–28.11.; ältere oder direkt auf Plattformen publizierte Inhalte bleiben unbekannt.
Unterschiedlicher Hash ist kein Neuheitsbeweis; Fingerprint-Ranking und Stichprobe wurden ergänzend genutzt.
Gleiche Captions von Foto und MP4 können Wiederholungen sein; R197-Kandidaten sind damit nicht pauschal geklärt.
Kein globales0-Doppelpost-Zertifikat und kein neues Publikationsregister.
